summary: Wearable Devices Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (WLDS/WLDSW), filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 23, 2026, announcing a Notice of Allowance from China's CNIPA for a patent application titled Method and Apparatus for a Gesture Controlled Interface for Wearable Devices. The allowance extends a U.S.-granted IP family covering wrist-worn nerve-conduction sensing and pressure-based gesture intensity control across consumer electronics, XR, robotics and physical AI. No securities, transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is implicated; the only structural note is incorporation by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. Not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle, only ordinary IP-portfolio news to watch.
